title: Prakas On Obligation To Report, Notify And Request For Approval Of Securities Firms And Investment Advisory Firms
text:
KINGDOM OF CAMBODIA
NATION RELIGION KING
*******
SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE
COMMISSION OF CAMBODIA
No. 008/18 SECC/BR.K
PRAKAS
ON
OBLIGATION TO REPORT, NOTIFY AND REQUEST FOR APPROVAL OF
SECURITIES FIRMS AND INVESTMENT ADVISORY FIRMS
*******
Deputy Prime Minister
Minister of Economy and Finance
And the Chairman of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Cambodia
- Having seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kret No. NS/RKT/0918/925 dated September
6, 2018 on the Appointment of the Royal Government of the Kingdom of
Cambodia;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kram No. NS/RKM/0618/012 dated June 28,
2018 promulgating the Law on the Organization and Functioning of the
Council of Ministers;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kram No. NS/RKM/0196/18 dated January
24, 1996 promulgating the Law on the Establishment of the Ministry of
Economy and Finance;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kram No. NS/RKM/0107/001 dated January
10, 2007 promulgating the Law on Government Securities;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kram No. NS/RKM/1007/028 dated October
19, 2007 promulgating the Law on the Issuance and Trading of Non-
Government Securities;
1 | Unofficial Translation

- Having seen the Anukret No. 97 ANKR.BK dated July 23, 2008 on the
Conduct and Organization of the Securities and Exchange Commission of
Cambodia;
- Having seen the Anukret No. 54 ANKR.BK dated April 8, 2009 on the
Implementation of the Law on the Issuance and Trading of Non-Government
Securities;
- Having seen the Prakas No. 008/11 SECC PR.K dated June 27, 2011 on the
Code of Conduct of Securities Firms and Securities Representatives;
- Having seen the Prakas No. 003/12 SECC PR.K dated June 28, 2012 on
Requirements of Financial Soundness of Securities Firms;
- Having seen the Prakas No. 001/18 SECC/PR.K dated March 20, 2018 on
Licensing and Supervision of Securities;
- Upon the approval by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Cambodia
in plenary meeting on October 4, 2018.
HEREBY DECIDES
CHAPTER 1
GENERAL PROVISION
Article 1.- Objective
The objective of this Prakas is to supervise and monitor the fulfillment of
obligations of securities frims and investment advisory firms licensed/authorised
by Securities and Exchange Commission of Cambodia (SECC).
Article 2.- Purpose
The purpose of this Prakas is to prescribe the obligations of securities firms
and investment advisory firms to report, notify and request for prior approval
from the Director Genaral of SECC in accordance with the Law on Issuance and
Trading of Non-government Securities and the Sub-decree on the Implementation
of the Law on Issuance and Trading of Non-government Securities, and other
regulations in securities sector.
Article 3.- Scope
This Prakas has a scope applying to securities firms and investment
advisory firms licensed/authorised by SECC.
2 | Unofficial Translation

Article 4.- Definitions
The technical terms used in this Prakas are defined in this Article and are
available in the glossaries of the annexes of the Law on Issuance and Trading of
Non-Government Securities and Anukret on the Implementation of the Law on
Issuance and Trading of Non-government Securities, as well as in the Prakas on
Licensing and Supervision of Securities Business and Prakas on the Code of
Conduct of Securities Firms and Securities Representatives.
Licensed/Authorised Firm or Firm refers to a securities firm and
investment advisory firm licensed/authorized by the Director General of SECC.
Business Office refers to a place which is equipped with adequate physical
facilities for the business of a licensed/authorised firm, and/or where its
business is conducted continuously, including:
a- Head office is an office where the principal business of a licensed/
authorised firm is conducted, and which is registered as a head office
pursuant to the Law on the Amendment of Commercial Rules and
Commercial Register;
b- Branch is a principal firm’s representative, and have no legal
personality separately from the principal firm, and which is registered
as a branch under the Law on Commercial Rules and Commercial
Register.
Change of Business Office Nature refers to change from head office to
branch or vice versa.
Senior Staff refers to the staff working for a firm in the position from
department director to chief executive officer including the head of securities
representatives, head of operations, compliance officer and internal auditor.
Qualified Persons refers to director, partner, chief executive officer, head
of operations, head of securities representatives and compliance officer receiving
qualification recognition from by the Director General of SECC.
Anukret refers to the Anukret on the Implementation of Law on Issuance
and Trading of Non-government Securities.
CHAPTER 2
REPORTING, NOTIFYING AND REQUESTING FOR APPROVAL
3 | Unofficial Translation

Article 5.- Monthly Reporting
A licensed/authorised firm shall submit to SECC the following monthly
reports:
1- Report detailing securities, fund and/or assets of each client kept by
the firm in accordance with Article 47 of the Anukret.
2- Report on handling of dispute and client complaints.
3- Updated list of client account specifying the clients who opened and
closed the account within the month.
Article 6.- Quarterly Reporting
A licensed/authorised firm shall submit to SECC the following quarterly
reports:
1- Quarterly internal financial statements prepared in accordance with the
Law on Corporate Accounting and Auditing, showing clearly the profit
structure.
2- Report on the securities trading of directors, partners, and employees of
the firm.
3- Internal control and compliance checklist.
4- Report detailing employees, qualified persons and licensed representa-
tives as well as dividing in each business unit.
Article 7.- Annual Reporting
A licensed/authorised firm shall submit to SECC the following annual
reports:
1- Annual financial statements audited by independent auditor and
prepared in accordance with the Law on Corporate Accounting and
Auditing;
2- Audit reports and other letters received from independent auditor;
3- Report on the achievements and challenges of licensed firms following
the business plan.
4- Professional indemnity insurance contract, if any.
5- Current structure of licensed/authorised firm including all holding/
parent company, subsidiaries, and branches of licensed/authorised
firm;
6- Certification letter from all related companies which guarantee the debt
obligations of licensed/authorised firm and relevant documents, if any;
4 | Unofficial Translation

7- Current organization chart of licensed/authorised firm;
8- Certification letter signed by an independent auditor of the company
providing audit service in securities sector in relation with securities,
fund or assets of clients in accordance with point 7 of Article 47 of
Anukret;
9- Other information determined by the Director General of SECC.
Article 8.- Reporting Date
A licensed/authorised firm shall submit reports to SECC in line with the
date as set below or within a time period determined by the Director General of
SECC:
1- Monthly report shall be submitted no later than the 10th day of the
following month;
2- Quarterly report shall be submitted no later than the 15th day of the
first month of the following quarter;
3- Annual report shall be submitted no later than the 31st March of the
following year.
In case the date mentioned in the paragraph (1) of this Article falls on
weekend or public holiday, a licensed/authorized firm shall submit reports in the
next business day.
Article 9.- Change in Management and Financial Status
A licensed/authorized firm shall immediately notify SECC in writing in
case of any changes that could affect on the firm’s business or clients as follows:
1- Material change in management circumstance of the firm;
2- Material change in assets of the firm;
3- Material change in credit or liabilities of the firm;
4- Material changes in the investment status of the firm;
5- Material change in the profit structure of the firm;
6- Other material changes in relation with management and financial
status of the firm.
The notification shall include an assessment of the impact of those changes
over the firm and its clients, and all actions or measures taken by the firm to
manage those changes.
Article 10.- Change of Risk Management and Internal Control Systems and
Business Plan
5 | Unofficial Translation

A licensed/authorized firm shall notify SECC in writing of any change of its
risk management system, internal control system and business plan within 7
(seven) days as from the date of change.
Article 11.- Insurance Claims and Change of Professional Insurance
Contract
In case a licensed/authorized firm makes a claim in the framework of
professional insurance contract or significantly changes the coverage of that
contract in relation with licensed/authorized business, the firm shall notify
SECC within 7 (seven) days after the claim or the change of that contract.
Article 12.- Notification of Offenses or Events Under Any Particular
Circumstance
A licensed/authorized firm shall immediately notify SECC if the firm, its
parent company, subsidiaries, branches, representative office, securities
representatives, or senior staff who are currently performing or finished the
functions, within their function committed offenses to the applicable law and
regulations:
1- are accused of criminal charges, guilty or convicted due to the offenses
of applicable law and regulations in any jurisdiction.
2- Are in the process of conviction in respect of any business activities, or
professional practice in securities sector in any jurisdiction.
3- Are subject to transactional fines, license/authorization suspension or
revocation or denied the registration/license/authorization by any
regulator, self-regulatory organization, or professional body in any
jurisdiction.
Article 13.- Change or Modify information
Except otherwise determined, a licensed/authorized firm shall immediately
notify SECC, in case of modifying documents or any material information
submitted to SECC in the license/license renewal/authorization/qualification
recognition application forms and its supporting documents.
A licensed/authorized firm shall request for prior approval from the
Director General of SECC for changes or modification as below:
1- Merge, take-over or cession of business operation;
2- Increase or decrease of capital.
6 | Unofficial Translation

Article 14.- Change or Cause Affecting License/Authorization
A licensed/authorized firm shall notify SECC in written within 7 (seven)
working days after any event or reasons that can cause the firm to the
liquidation, dissolving, suspension or cease of securities business.
A licensed/authorized firm shall request for prior approval from the
Director General of SECC when the firm intends to begin the liquidation,
dissolving, suspension or cease of securities business.
A licensed/authorized firm shall notify SECC in written of the absence from
the firm without reason, resignation, position termination or change of function
of qualified persons within 7 (seven) working days after the absence from the firm
without reason for consecutive 7 (seven) days or receiving notification or
resignation letter or position termination or change of position of that person.
Article 15.- Cease of Securities Business
A licensed/authorized firm shall request for approval from the Director
General of SECC to cease securities business, attaching with the procedures and
documents related to the cease of securities business within at least 6 (six)
months before the day of business termination. Termination of business,
procedures, and the period of procedure implementation shall receive an
approval from the Director General of SECC. In case the implementation of the
procedure of business termination uses time beyond the approved time period,
the Director General of SECC has rights to determine additional time period.
The termination of securities business shall be applied by the same
procedures as stipulated in the Anukret on Rehabilitaion and Liquidation in
Securities Sector in case of voluntary liquidation.
Article 16.- Establishment of Subsidiary or Business Representative Office
Before establishing subsidiary, opening or closing business representative
office, a licensed/authorized firm shall request for approval from the Director
General of SECC by fulfilling the conditions determined by SECC.
The reports, that the licensed/authorized firm has to submit to SECC in
compliance with the applicable law and regulations, shall include the information
related to subsidiaries and business representative offices in the country and
abroad.
A licensed/authorized firm shall notify SECC within 7 (seven) working days
after receiving the notice of inspection or investigation or sanctions issued by
7 | Unofficial Translation

authority or competent court in relation with the subsidiary or business
representative office of the firm.
Article 17.- Susbsidiary and Holding/Parent Company
A licensed/authorized firm shall immediately notify SECC in case any of
the following occurs to its subsidiary or holding/parent company in the country
or abroad:
1- Suspension of business, suspension or revocation of license/registra-
tion/authorization;
2- Merge or cession of business in part or in whole;
3- Prohibition or restriction on issuing checks;
4- Resolution of dissolution;
5- Commencement of any procedure related to bankruptcy;
6- Securities-related scandal or offenses or accused of offenses against law
or legal complaint;
7- Others cases required by the Director General of SECC.
Article 18.- Notification of Trading
A licensed/authorized firm shall immediately notify SECC by verbal or
other means determined by the Director General of SECC and in writing in case
the trading of the licensed/authorized firm or its directors, partners, employees
and clients may have or has an impact on the conduct of securities market or the
interest of public investors.
Article 19.- Reports on Securities Underwriting Status
A securities underwriter shall provide SECC with the following information:
1- All memorandums of understanding and agreements related to
securities underwriting and/or sub-underwriting.
2- Total securities underwriting amount in cash;
3- Potential liabilities owed to other parties, if any;
4- Securities sub-underwriter, if any;
5- Evidence of securities sub-underwriting, if any;
6- Securities underwriting risk;
7- Any information related to the financial position of the firm.
The securities underwriter entering into sub-underwriting agreement shall
provide SECC with the following information:
1- Total securities sub-underwriting amount in cash;
8 | Unofficial Translation

2- Potential liabilities owed to other parties, if any;
3- Securities sub-underwriting risk;
4- Any information related to the financial position of the firm.
The securities underwriter and the securities sub-underwriter shall submit
to SECC, within 7 (seven) working days, the reports and information as
stipulated in paragraph (1) and (2) of this Article after signing securities
underwriting or sub-underwriting agreement with a listed company, and shall
submit to SECC every consecutive change, except for point (1) of paragraph (1) of
this Article that the firm shall submit immediately to SECC after that the firm
signed the memorandum of understanding and/or relevant agreements.
CHAPTER 3
OTHER PROVISIONS
Article 20.- Diligence on Reporting
Reports and information in accordance with law, Anukret, and this Prakas
shall be prepared carefully and diligently to ensure accuracy, clarity and
completeness. If any error or defect is detected, a licensed/authorized firm shall
immediately notify SECC in writing and resubmit the new report with edited
information.
Article 21.- Obligation to Provide Information and Documents upon
Request.
A licensed/authorized firm and/or securities representative shall submit
information and other relevant documents upon the request of the Director
General of SECC in order to determine the accuracy of licensed/authorized firm
and/or licensed representative in compliance with law, regulations or instruction
of the Director General of SECC.
Article 22.- Form of Report and Information Provision
Reports and information pursuant to this Prakas shall be made in writing
or other means determined by the Director General of SECC and in soft copy.
CHAPTER 4
PENALTIES
Article 23. - Transactional Fine
9 | Unofficial Translation

Without considering other sanctions as stipulated in the law and regulation
in force in the Kingdong of Cambodia, the licensed/authorized firm committing
the offenses against Article 5, Article 6, Article 7, Article 9, Article 10, Article 11,
Article 12, Article 13, Article 14, Article 15, Article 16, Article 17, Article 18,
Article 19, Article 20, Article 21, Article 22 or providing false information
intentionally or with significant negligence or not complying with the instruction
or requirement of the Director General of SECC shall be subject to the
administrative sanction as prescribed in Article 24 of this Prakas and/or
transactional fine from SECC in cash not more than KHR200,000,000 (two
hundred million).
A licensed/authorized firm being late in providing reports, notifying or
replying in respect of time period or date as prescribed in Article 8, Article 10,
Article 11, paragraph (1) and (3) of Article 14, paragraph (3) of Article 16 or
paragraph (3) of Article 19 of this Prakas shall be subject to the administrative
sanction as stipulated in Aritcle 24 of this Prakas and/or transactional fine from
SECC in cash as follows:
1- KHR1,000,000 (one million) per day for being late in providing report or
sending notification to SECC.
2- KHR400,000 (rour hundred thousand) per day for being late in replying
or providing other information to SECC.
Article 24. - Administrative Sanction
Administrative sanctions are as follow:
1- Warning;
2- Correction order;
3- Suspension or dismissal of director and/or senior staff;
4- Restriction on license/authorization;
5- Suspension or revocation of license/authorization.
CHAPTER 5
FINAL PROVISIONS
Article 25.- Guideline
The Director General of SECC may issue guidelines in accordance with
law, Anukret, and this Prakas to facilitate the understanding and implement-
tation.
10 | Unofficial Translation

Article 26.- Contravention
Any provision that contradicts this Prakas shall be hereby repealed.
Article 27.- Implementation
The Director General of SECC, Director of Securities Intermediaries
Supervision Department, Director of Legal Affairs Department, all directors of
deparments-unit of SECC and relevant persons shall implement this Prakas in
respect of their duties as from the signing date.
Phnom Penh, October 30, 2018
Deputy Prime Minister, Minister of Economy and Finance
and Chairman of Securities and Exchange Commission of
Cambodia
(signature and seal)
Dr. AUN PORNMONIROTH
